nina: FYI - console preview says ALLOW for svc:etl on /v1/upload but auth-service returns DENY. Repro on staging with inherited role + per-route deny.
ash: Can you paste the minimal repro and timestamps?
nina: Create role `etl-uploader` -> scope dataset:ingest; create `team-uploader` that inherits it and add per-route deny for /v1/upload on tenant:big-corp. Preview response includes header Policy-Stamp: ps-20260403-0904, live auth has policy_rev pr-20260403-0907.
vikram: Likely snapshot lag from reconcile leader failover. UX proposal: show "Policy stamp: ps-..." in mono and an orange pill if stamp != live rev. Add a small "Compare revisions" action that calls cheap compare endpoint.
ash: Backend plan: add headers X-Policy-Stamp and X-Policy-Revision to preview responses. Implement GET /api/preview/compare?tenant=... that returns one-line JSON with snapshot_stamp, live_rev, consistent. Use redis index written by reconcile leader for O(1) compare. No heavy reconcile on UI path.
nina: Nice. Also add a redacted trace id header X-Policy-Trace when sampled, stored ephemeral in redis TTL=3600s. On user click, console fetches trace which shows role->binding->route decision (no principal ids).
vikram: Telemetry: emit preview.compare.mismatch and preview.stamp_age_seconds. Alert if mismatch_rate > 0.5% per tenant in 1h.
reconcile-bot: Reconcile leader rotated at 1765440060; reconcile resumed at 1765440118.
nina: Assignments: ash -> add headers + UI pill PR; vikram -> compare endpoint spec + monitor; ash -> add trace sampling; nina -> UI mock & acceptance test. We'll keep force_reconcile hidden for now.
ash: I'll start the header PR today.
vikram: I'll draft the compare endpoint and monitor playbook.
reconcile-bot: Permission cache invalidated for tenant:big-corp at 1765440085.
nina: Thanks all. Quick win: header + pill this sprint. We'll follow with traces and alerts next week.
